items.title: Campaigns: why people were skipped + who to leave out
items.detail: In a campaign's details, the Skipped tab shows the reasons with counts (bought in the last N days, ignored the last 2 campaigns, got a campaign in the last N days, got a follow-up, opted out …). The wizard has a new 'Who to leave out' box: days since a purchase, days between two campaigns and the ignored-2-campaigns switch, for that campaign only.
items.where: WhatsApp → Campaigns → a campaign → Skipped; New campaign → step with the Send time

items.title: Customers' automatic replies leave Requests
items.detail: When a customer's business app answers our message by itself ("Thank you for contacting …", "We're unavailable right now, but will respond as soon as possible"), that chat is resolved automatically and no bot / flow / query typing runs on it. When the customer really writes later, the chat comes back to Requests. Chats already waiting in Requests that only have such replies are cleaned every 5 minutes.

items.title: Quick entry: Order type (Personal / AiSensy / Myntra / Amazon / Flipkart)
items.detail: 'Add orders' has an Order type above the Sales person. The order ID shows the type (for example Myntra-0123), the orders are counted as before, and they now also appear on the Order Allocation page with the salesperson and panel they were saved with; changing the allocation there updates the order.
items.where: Sales → Orders → Add orders; Sales → Allocation

items.title: Rates & weights page
items.detail: One Admin page for the things that change with dates: the weight of each bottle size (a new version applies from the date you choose, old orders keep their old weights) and the payment proof rules.

items.title: Payment proof with two screenshots
items.detail: A prepaid or part-prepaid manual order needs the customer's paid screen and the receiver's screen. They must show the same amount and UTR, the money must go to TM Perfume House / Fourpirates Ventures LLP, and the UTR must be new. Otherwise the order is refused with the reason. The gateway (Razorpay, Quick, UPI QR, Bank transfer) is read from the receiver's screen.
items.where: WhatsApp chat → 🧾 Manual order; the sheet shows both screenshots

items.title: Manual order sheet
items.detail: Tap an order ID to see the customer, the perfumes as they go to Dispatch, weight, total / prepaid / COD / tax, payment proof, commission and how it was counted, shipment. New export: one row per order, every perfume in one cell.
items.where: Dispatch → Manual orders → Manual order sheet (also Sales → Orders → Manual orders)

items.title: WhatsApp manual order details open correctly
items.detail: Clicking WM-xxxxx on Order Allocation no longer shows the Shopify 404; it shows the perfumes, customer, address, total, prepaid and COD.

items.title: Quick entry: choose the sales person

items.title: Ideal day vs actual (Campaign)
items.detail: Hour-by-hour table from 12 noon to 12 noon: spend, replies and campaign orders so far against the ideal. Hours are shown as running totals.
